summary: The note presents profiles of empty nesters who turned the quiet after their children left home in autumn 2023 into a time of growth. Examples include a painter, a couple on an RV trip, a community gardener, a meditation host, a returning college student, and couples and individuals building new relationships. It frames empty nest syndrome as a period of loss that can lead to rediscovery, purpose and connection.
one_line: Profiles of parents who, after their children left home in 2023, found new passions, adventures, service, learning and relationships in the empty nest.
key_facts: September 15, 2023 is described as the start of a new chapter for countless parents whose youngest or only child left for higher education or careers.
Mary Johnson, a 52-year-old former school teacher from Boulder, Colorado, sent her youngest son to college on September 3, 2023 and returned to painting.
Mary Johnson held her first local art exhibition in December 2023, and her art now hangs in several community centers.
Thomas and Elizabeth Wright of Nashville, Tennessee, bought a modest RV around October 10, 2023 after their twin daughters enrolled in universities on opposite coasts.
The Wrights share their cross-country travels with other empty nesters on an online blog called "Wheels of Wrights."
David Lee, 60, of Syracuse, New York, became a mainstay at the local community garden and taught gardening classes to children and adults.
The Syracuse city council honored David Lee with a community service award on November 22, 2023 for his work on urban greening initiatives.
Susan Chang, 58, of San Francisco, a former stay-at-home mom, turned her son's old bedroom into a meditation space after he pursued acting in New York.
Alex Thompson, 55, of Portland, Oregon, returned to college in fall 2023 to finish the degree he never completed and is studying history.
Janet and Mark Rivera of Miami, Florida, took up salsa dance classes together after their son moved out in late September.
Laura Henderson, a librarian from Seattle, Washington, joined a monthly book club in October 2023.
